Slepgar was an ogre from the Gordunni in Feralas recruited by Malus to be part of the group known as Gordok's Elite, to aid in his search for Aramar Thorne. Slepgar had pale-red skin and was massive in size, standing easily at twelve feet in height, with "muscles piled upon muscles". He was constantly sleepy, and whenever awake he was usually seen yawning. His weapon of choice was a tremendously large war club.

.]]__NOTOC__ The Slithering Gulch is a long, shallow ravine that stretches across northern Vol'dun—from the Crater of Conquerors in the west to the Serpent's Maw in the east—and forms a gap between the Crackling Ridge in the south and Skycallers' Spire in the north. It serves as a marketplace for the Faithless sethrak where dealers auction off slaves from the Crater of Conquerors to the empire's common citizens. In the central and eastern parts, the Slithering Gulch subzone extends beyond the gulch itself and onto large cliffs on its southern side. From these cliffs, one can cross a huge stone bridge to the Thundering Terrace at the base of Skycallers' Spire or—further east—a smaller bridge

Slitherdrake Roost is a large cave in northeastern Zaralek Cavern. As implied by the name, the cave was a roost of the slitherdrakes that had escaped from Aberrus, but has since been occupied by black dragonspawn poachers still loyal to Neltharion under the command of Overseer Xymra. Players explore the roost late in chapter four of the Embers of Neltharion campaign on the quests Break Them Out (Zaralek Cavern) and Worst of the Worst (Zaralek Cavern). The roost is bordered by the Deepflayer Nest to the southeast, Glitterspore Lake to the south, the Acidbite Ravine to the southwest, Battlefield Ruins and Obsidian Spire Outpost to the west, and Obsidian Rest to the northwest.

Slitherdrakes are a type of dragonkin discovered in Zaralek Cavern underneath the Dragon Isles. They possess long, serpentine bodies and four legs, as well as wings and are equally at home in the depths of the earth and far reaches of the sky. They were created in Aberrus, but managed to escape, leading to lingering Neltharion loyalists to attempt to recapture them. Their attempts were foiled by Ebyssian and an adventurer, with one of the drakes becoming a mount for the adventurer.

A Smoke Flare is a pyrotechnic device used primarily to mark a location on the terrain. The Smoke Flare item does this by placing a smoke column object on the terrain. Any placeable object can mark terrain, but in order to be useful the marking object must be: *Visible over a distance - in WoW, the Smoke Flare smoke column are as visible as any large object gets. *Persistent - the Smoke Flare smoke columns persist for five minutes. Some uses that people have come up with: * marking locations for raids * smoke bomb the Flag Rooms in the Warsong Gulch battleground * props for floor shows and fashion shows

Smity Hammerhead is a goblin blacksmith vendor located at the Hardwrench Hideaway in the Cape of Stranglethorn.
Smilin' Timmy Sticks is a training dummy located at the Wild Shore in the Cape of Stranglethorn. Ironpatch uses it as target practice for new recruits. He later joins the Battle for Booty Bay.
Smashed Robot Parts are found in the Brawler's Purse, awarded to victorious gladiators in the Brawler's Guild.
Small Shield is sold by the following vendors for : * in Teldrassil * in Azuremyst Isle * in Darnassus * in Elwynn Forest * in Dun Morogh * in The Exodar

Small Piles of Gold Coins can be picked up from Small Pile of Coins during Stage 7 of the Pursuing the Black Harvest scenario. It turns into a sellable version upon completion of Plunder the Black Temple.

There are two Smoldering Chests in the yaungol territories of Timeless Isle. One inside the ruins of a building at in the Firewalker Ruins, and another at in the Shrine of the Black Flame. Each may only be opened once per character. The chests are well-guarded, and thus contain more coins and tokens than other chests on the Isle. They each have roughly 300 Timeless Coin and 2 Timeless armor tokens.
Smoldering Eye is a possible drop from Ordos, the world boss yaungol on the Timeless Isle.

Smart Cursor: When your mouse cursor moves over an object or character that you can interact with, it changes shape to reflect a new action you can perform.

Small Crescent Saberfish are caught in all waters in and around for those with fishing skill under ~625. Players will rarely catch them with fishing skill above 650. Gutting them produces a random amount of Crescent Saberfish Flesh. This can also be down automatically while fishing if Bladebone Hook has been applied.

Small Sea Scorpions are caught in the seas around for those with fishing skill under ~625. Players will rarely catch them with fishing skill above 650. Gutting them produces a random amount of Sea Scorpion Segment. This can also be down automatically while fishing if Bladebone Hook has been applied.
